html:
Enjoy a full-day escape to the cool climate of Ba Na Hills ( Da Nang City ), ride one of the world’s most impressive cable car systems, walk on the legendary Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands, and have fun at one of Asia’s top indoor theme parks.

ITINERARY

07:30–08:30 – Hotel Pick-up

Our English-speaking guide and driver pick you up from your hotel in Da Nang.

Depart for Ba Na Hills along one of the most beautiful seaside roads in Central Vietnam.

09:00 – Arrive at Ba Na Hills – First Cable Car Ride

Reach Ba Na Hills and board the UNESCO record-holding cable car system, famous for its height and length.

On the way up, enjoy spectacular views of:

  • Mo Stream

  • Toc Tien Waterfall with its dazzling white spray

  • Lush forests and misty mountains

Golden Bridge And French Village Area

Visit the iconic sights on Ba Na Hills:

  • Golden Bridge – “Hands of the Gods” holding a curved golden bridge in the sky, one of the most famous landmarks in Vietnam.

  • L’Jardin d’Amour Zone with French-inspired architecture, including:

    • Tinh Tam Garden

    • The old French stable

    • Hundred-year-old pomelo tree

    • Ancient villas

  • Linh Ung Pagoda – with a 27m-high Buddha statue and peaceful gardens

  • Loc Uyen Garden – a beautiful landscaped garden perfect for photos

11:30 – Second Cable Car to Nui Chua Peak & Lunch

From Debay Station, take the second cable car line to Nui Chua Peak – the rooftop of Da Nang City.

Enjoy a buffet lunch at Ba Na Hills.

Afternoon – Fantasy Park And Summit Attractions

Continue your exploration with:

  • Fantasy Park – one of Asia’s most modern indoor game centers. Enjoy a wide range of games and rides for all ages (most included).

  • Linh Chua Linh Tu Temple – Visit this spiritual site and enjoy a panoramic view of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay, often seen through a romantic layer of mist from Ba Na’s peak.

15:00–15:15 – Cable Car Down & Return to Da Nang

Take the cable car back down the mountain and board the coach to return to Da Nang city center.

17:00–17:30 – Hotel Drop-off

Arrive back at your hotel.

End of services. Goodbye & see you again!

TOUR PRICE

54 USD / pax

INCLUDED

  • Transfer by air-conditioned coach in good condition.

  • Professional English-speaking guide.

  • Buffet lunch in Ba Na Hills.

  • Round-trip cable car tickets.

  • Entrance fees for all sightseeing as per itinerary.

  • Mineral water.

NOTES & CHILDREN POLICY

Notes:

Please provide the following personal information when booking:

  • Full name
  • Year of birth
  • Gender
  • Nationality
  • Contact details

Children Policy:

  • Under 1m: Free of charge (share lunch with parents).

  • From 1m to under 1.4m: 80% of adult price.

  • From 1.4m and above: Charged as adult.
